registered: 2026-11-25, before VehicleDynamics.lateral_load_transfer was run on these cases
reference_tool: OpenSeesPy 3.8 (Pacific Earthquake Engineering Research Center), linear static: a rigid sprung body (rigid links) joined to a rigid front and rear axle at each axle's roll centre, translations and pitch/yaw tied, roll resisted by a rotational spring of that axle's roll stiffness; tyres as vertical supports at half track. Weight and m*a_y at the CG.
model_note: This is the same idealisation as Milliken (RCVD ch. 18) and Gillespie: rigid chassis, all mass sprung, lateral force reacted through each axle's roll centre. It checks that KinematiK implements it correctly (split of the lateral force, roll-axis height at the CG, roll-stiffness split, signs), not that the idealisation fits a real car.
